=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:408-413 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The provenance check trusts issue comments based on author association or a bot login instead of verifying that the comment was authored by the authenticated phase-reporter account.
  WHY: A collaborator able to post comments and dispatch reports can link a genuine failed run from an unrelated issue, causing a forged report to proceed; severity disagreement: deepseek and qwen rated this MAJOR, while Gemini and OpenAI rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:285-318 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: PHASE_JOBS_FILE is defined but is never fetched or populated before being passed to the provenance verifier.
  WHY: The verifier reads an empty or missing jobs file and returns "no_failed_phase_job", causing legitimate phase failure reports to be dropped as unverified.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:294-304 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Failed run-details or paginated-comment API fetches do not log enough diagnostic context to distinguish API failures or partial fetches from other provenance failures.
  WHY: Operators see only generic unverified details and cannot determine whether reports were dropped due to an outage, rate limit, or partial response; severity disagreement: deepseek rated these NIT, while Gemini rated the API failure finding MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:395-398 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The reporter-job exclusion uses case-sensitive literal-string comparisons against a duplicated "heal-report" constant.
  WHY: A future workflow job rename or casing change could leave this constant out of sync and allow a failed reporter job to count as a failed phase job.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:143 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: PHASE_REPORT_REPORTER_JOB duplicates a job-name string hardcoded elsewhere in workflow configurations and label definitions.
  WHY: A future rename or casing change in the workflow job definition could silently desynchronize the constant, causing verification to fail and drop reports.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:285-318 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The provenance block adds two GitHub API calls per phase_failure intake without a separate kill switch or feature flag.
  WHY: Slow or rate-limited source-repository API calls can delay every qualifying phase report, and disabling this check independently would require a code change.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:286
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: PHASE_RUN_ID is extracted and used as a filename without explicit shell-level numeric validation.
  WHY: The script relies solely on previous payload validation before using this value.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:408-413 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The linking-comment trust check accepts any comment whose author has author_association OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR or whose login is github-actions[bot].
  WHY: A credential with repo: push scope can post a failure-prefixed comment linking a real failed run on an unrelated issue, then dispatch a forged report that passes provenance checks and creates or escalates a heal issue.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:294-296 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the run-details API call fails, the script removes the JSON file without a diagnostic log line about the failure type.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish transient GitHub API failures from mismatched or forged reports.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:300-304 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: If the paginated comment fetch partially succeeds and then fails, the script discards the fetched pages without logging the partial state.
  WHY: Operators lack context when tracking down recurring drops, even though discarding partial data is correct for fail-closed security.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:395-398 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The reporter-job exclusion uses case-sensitive literal-string comparisons against a module-level constant duplicating "heal-report".
  WHY: A future workflow rename could leave the constant out of sync, allowing a failed reporter job to count as a failed phase job.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:285-318 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The provenance block adds two GitHub API calls per phase_failure intake run without a separate kill switch or feature flag.
  WHY: If the API is slow or rate-limited, qualifying phase reports can be delayed before they are processed or dropped.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:408-413 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The verifier trusts any comment posted by an OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR on the issue thread, instead of verifying the author was the authenticated phase-reporter account.
  WHY: A credential authorized to dispatch a heal report can post a failure-prefixed comment linking to a genuine failed phase run on an unrelated issue, permitting creation or escalation of a forged heal issue.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:285-318 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: PHASE_JOBS_FILE is defined but is never fetched or populated before being passed to the provenance verifier.
  WHY: The verifier reads an empty or missing jobs file and returns "no_failed_phase_job", causing legitimate phase failure reports to be dropped as unverified.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:294, 300 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If API calls fail, the JSON files are removed or not created, and the report is dropped with only a generic "phase_report_unverified" detail.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish security-spoof attempts from transient infrastructure issues, hindering triage and remediation.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:143 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: PHASE_REPORT_REPORTER_JOB duplicates the job-name string hardcoded elsewhere in workflow configurations and label definitions.
  WHY: A future rename or casing change could silently desynchronize the constant, causing verification to fail and drop reports.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:286
  PROBLEM: PHASE_RUN_ID is extracted and used as a filename without explicit shell-level numeric validation.
  WHY: The script relies solely on previous payload validation before usage.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  WHY: A repo collaborator who can dispatch repository_dispatch can add a failure-prefixed comment linking to a genuine failed run on an unrelated issue, allowing the forged report to proceed to heal-issue creation.
